summary: Froze the shared-cost allocation contract as a docs-only slice written into project/specs/PH-305.md (per the Lead's BASE correction the whitelist has no docs/adr/ path, so no new ADR file). The contract covers: the shared pool limited to posted cost facts whose ledger scope is nonproject/unallocated (currently PH-217 nonproject/unallocated labor only), explicitly excluding PH-250 one-off fee cost because PH-250 posts it as project-scoped cost (cost posting 200, scope=project) and it is therefore direct project cost that must not be reallocated or double counted (T09); a deterministic pool_key = sha256(org|period|pool_kind|ordered source-ref digest) with mutually exclusive source membership and overlap detection (source_in_multiple_pools); append-only SharedCostAllocationBatch with kind allocation/reversal, allocation draft->posted and reversal draft->posted while the original allocation transitions posted->reversed (status bit only, amounts/detail immutable), a conditional unique effective-positive predicate (kind=allocation AND status=posted AND reversed_by_ref IS NULL) so a posted reversal batch does not collide with the single-effective-batch rule, correction by exact negative mirror of the original detail (no recomputation, reversal batch terminal); driver enum revenue/approved-minutes/direct-cost/fixed weights; integer basis points summing 10000 with ROUND_HALF_UP and last-target residual for positive batches (items >=0, sum==amount) while reversal batches mirror the original items exactly (items <=0, sum==negative amount); no net company cost increase (costing/ledger owner append-only re-scope, no direct ledger edits); read-only reconciliation with frozen issue codes; request_token receipts, org lock, dry_run, period/lock checks; immutable history with reversal+new batch in an open period and algorithm_version; role matrix/history_read; owner boundaries; and the PH-313 write-side relation (no implementation authorization, no canonical topic/command). The report also records the four review blockers fixed after reviewer-b's rejection and the actual pre-review commands at the rebased candidate HEAD with --base c2c76d8.
